## What changes and why?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks run and relevant results. Note any platform you could not test.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and kept the change focused.
- [ ] I added regression coverage for behavior changes, or explained why it is unnecessary.
- [ ] I updated documentation/changelog where appropriate.
- [ ] I included no credentials, generated binaries, or release archives.
- [ ] For scanning or cleanup changes, I considered missed references and unintended deletion.
